assets.style: Epic cinematic matte painting, near-photographic lighting, dramatic golden hour, volumetric haze, high contrast, wide 16:9 thumbnail composition with one clear focal point. No text, no letters, no watermark.
images: A colossal concrete dam seen from a low dramatic angle: on the LEFT side huge stormy Atlantic waves smash against the top of the wall at full sea level, on the RIGHT side the sea has dropped 200 metres and the exposed dry seabed lies far below with tiny stranded ships tilted on cracked mud, the dam wall towering between the two worlds, the Rock of Gibraltar in the background
